title: Head of Industrialization
description:
**Designation: Head of Industrialization**

**Department: Industrialization**

**Location: Tirupur, Tamil Nadu**

**Job Purpose**

The Head – Industrialization will lead the Industrialization function and drive

standardization, cost optimization, productivity improvement, and technical

excellence across garment manufacturing operations. The role will establish robust

manufacturing standards from product development through bulk production,

ensuring accurate SMV, costing, consumption, CPM, technical feasibility, and SOP

implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SMV – Method & Time Study**

* Lead method study, time study, operation breakdown, and SMV setting

for new and existing styles.

* Establish accurate and achievable SMVs based on standardized methods,

machines, and operator performance.

* Identify productivity improvement opportunities through method engineering,

line balancing and process optimization.

* Periodically review SMVs against actual production performance and update

standards where required.

**2. Product Costing**

* Drive accurate product costing covering fabric, trims, sewing, processing,

overheads, efficiency, rejection, and other manufacturing parameters.

* Validate costing assumptions with actual manufacturing data and ensure cost

competitiveness.

* Support Merchandising, Sourcing, and Manufacturing teams during product

development and order finalization.

* Identify cost-reduction opportunities without compromising quality or product

specifications.

**3. CPM – Cost Per Minute**

* Establish and maintain standardized CPM benchmarks across products,

operations, and manufacturing units.

* Analyze actual versus standard CPM and identify key cost and efficiency

gaps.

* Work closely with IE and Production teams to improve operational efficiency

and manufacturing cost performance.

**4. Consumption**

* Drive accurate fabric and garment consumption standards during product

development and pre-production.

* Validate consumption through marker efficiency, fabric width, shrinkage,

construction, and wastage parameters.

* Monitor actual versus standard consumption and initiate corrective actions for

deviations.

**5. Technical Support**

* Provide technical support for new product development, proto/sample,

pre-production, and bulk production.

* Evaluate manufacturing feasibility, construction, operation sequence, machine

requirements, and process risks.

* Resolve technical issues in coordination with Design, Merchandising, Quality,

Production, and Sourcing teams.

**6. SOP & amp; Documentation**

* Develop and maintain standardized SOPs, work instructions, technical standards, and process documentation.
* Ensure effective implementation of industrialization standards across factories.
* Establish systems for periodic review, audit, and continuous improvement of technical standards.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong expertise in Industrial Engineering, garment manufacturing, SMV, costing, CPM, and consumption.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills.
* Strong understanding of garment construction, manufacturing processes, and production systems.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive standardization across multiple manufacturing units.
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Experience & amp; Qualification**

* 10–15+ years of relevant experience in garment manufacturing / Industrial Engineering / Industrialization.
* Degree/Diploma in Textile Technology, Apparel Technology, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
* Strong proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and industrial engineering tools.

title: Head - Central Planning
description:
**Job Title: Head of Central Planning**

**Location: Tirupur, Tamil Nadu**

**Experience: 10–15 years of experience in garment manufacturing**

**JOB PURPOSE**

Lead the centralised manufacturing planning function across all manufacturing units,

ensuring optimum capacity utilisation, effective order allocation, balanced factory

loading, material readiness, production execution and on-time delivery.

**CENTRAL PLANNING & STRATEGY**

* Develop and manage the overall central planning strategy across

manufacturing units.

* Establish standard planning processes, systems, formats and review

mechanisms.

* Consolidate business requirements and convert them into realistic

manufacturing plans.

* Develop monthly, quarterly and annual manufacturing plans aligned with

business projections.

* Drive proactive rather than reactive planning across the organisation.

**CAPACITY PLANNING & FACTORY LOADING**

* Develop factory-wise and line-wise capacity plans based on SMV, efficiency,

working days, product complexity and available resources.

* Allocate orders to factories based on capability, capacity and delivery

requirements.

* Ensure optimum and balanced utilisation of manufacturing capacity.
* Identify capacity gaps, excess capacity and future capacity requirements.
* Recommend capacity redistribution, additional shifts, outsourcing or capacity

expansion where required.

**ORDER & PRODUCTION PLANNING**

* Manage end-to-end order planning from order confirmation to production

completion.

* Prepare production plans aligned with committed delivery dates.
* Monitor planned vs. actual production, WIP, efficiency and order

completion.

* Prioritise critical orders and develop recovery plans for delayed orders.
* Ensure production plans are realistic, achievable and continuously updated.

**RAW MATERIAL & MATERIAL READINESS**

* Coordinate with Sourcing - Fabric, Sewing Trims and Packing Trims teams

to ensure material readiness.

* Monitor material availability against planned production requirements.
* Identify material shortages or delays that may impact production.
* Ensure production plans are aligned with actual material availability.
* Establish early-warning mechanisms for critical material risks.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION**

* Work closely with:
* Merchandising
* Sourcing - RM
* Production
* Industrial Engineering
* Quality
* Factory Heads
* Commercial & Logistics

Ensure business commitments, material availability, factory capacity and production

plans remain aligned.

**INDUSTRIAL ENGINEERING & EFFICIENCY**

* Work with IE teams to validate SMV, efficiency and capacity assumptions.
* Monitor planned vs. actual efficiency.
* Identify productivity gaps affecting capacity.
* Support line balancing, bottleneck reduction and capacity improvement.
* Incorporate product complexity and learning curves into planning.

**DELIVERY & RISK MANAGEMENT**

* Establish an early-warning system for delivery risks.
* Identify bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production delays in advance.
* Drive corrective and recovery actions with relevant teams.
* Monitor critical orders through regular review mechanisms.
* Develop contingency plans for capacity, material and production disruptions.

**MIS, SYSTEMS & ANALYTICS**

* Develop central planning dashboards and management MIS.
* Ensure accurate visibility of orders, capacity, production, WIP, material

readiness and delivery status.

* Drive ERP-based planning and data accuracy.
* Utilise Advanced Excel / Power BI for planning analysis and decision-making.
* Establish meaningful planning KPIs and performance dashboards.

**TEAM LEADERSHIP**

* Lead and develop the Central Planning / PPC team.
* Define clear KRAs, KPIs and accountability.
* Build planning capability through training and process improvement.
* Promote data-driven decision-making and strong planning discipline.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Capacity Utilisation
* Factory Loading Accuracy
* Production Plan Adherence
* On-Time Production
* On-Time Shipment
* Planning Accuracy
* Material Readiness
* WIP Control
* Production Efficiency
* Order Ageing
* Bottleneck Resolution
* Reduction in Last-Minute / Emergency Planning

**QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor degree in Textile, Apparel, Production, Industrial Engineering

or related discipline.

* 10–15 years of experience in garment manufacturing with strong exposure

to Central Planning / PPC.

* Experience in multi-factory planning and capacity management is

preferred.

* Strong knowledge of garment manufacturing, SMV, efficiency, capacity

planning and production systems.

* Strong analytical, leadership, communication and stakeholder-management

skills.

* Proficiency in ERP, Advanced Excel and Power BI/MIS preferred.
* Experience in sportswear / activewear manufacturing will be an added

advantage.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

The ideal candidate should be a strong strategic and execution-oriented manufacturing planner who can connect business demand with manufacturing capacity and ensure the right order is planned at the right factory, with the right material and capacity, at the right time. The role requires strong ownership, analytical thinking, decision-making, cross- functional coordination and execution discipline to build a scalable and proactive central planning function.

title: Factory Manager
description:
Company: Tirupur Hub Private Limited

Industry: Knitwear / Apparel Export Manufacturing

Location: Nochipalayam, Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu

Experience: 6–15 years

Salary: ₹55,000–₹1,20,000 per month (negotiable based on experience)

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Factory Manager to oversee the complete operations of our knitwear export manufacturing unit. The candidate will be responsible for production planning, operational efficiency, manpower management, quality standards, cost control, and timely execution of customer orders.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in knitwear manufacturing, preferably in an export-oriented garment factory, with the ability to lead multiple departments and ensure smooth coordination between production, merchandising, sampling, fabric, and quality teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee end-to-end factory operations and production planning.
* Manage production teams, supervisors, and departmental heads.
* Monitor production targets, line efficiency, and manpower productivity.
* Ensure quality standards and timely order execution.
* Coordinate with merchandising, sampling, fabric, and quality teams.
* Control production costs, wastage, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure smooth execution of buyer orders and shipment schedules.

**Requirements**

* Strong experience in knitwear garment manufacturing.
* Previous experience in an export garment factory preferred.
* Excellent leadership, planning, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage teams and meet production deadlines.

title: IE Executive
description:
**Job Title: I**
E Executive

**Industry:**
Garment / Apparel Manufacturing

**Department:**
Industrial Engineering

**Experience:**
2–3 Years

**Work Location:**
Tirupur, Tamil Nadu

**Job Purpose**

To support the Brand Industrial Engineering function through SMV calculation, Line layout planning and analysis, Method improvement, and Video study with a strong focus on productivity, efficiency improvement, and continuous SMV reduction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SMV & Method Study**

* Develop, analyse, and maintain accurate SMVs for garment products.
* Strong understanding of SMV calculation, Operation Breakdown, Work Measurement, and Sewing Methods.
* Identify and implement improved sewing methods to reduce operation time and improve productivity.
* Continuously identify opportunities for SMV reduction through better methods, Machine attachments, and Work aids.
* Study best sewing methods in vendor factories and support implementation across other factories.
* Knowledge of SMV/IE software will be an added advantage.

**2. Line Layout Planning & Analysis**

* Prepare production line layouts based on SMV, operation breakdown, manpower, machine requirements, and achievable production targets.
* Review and improve layouts based on actual production performance.
* Visit vendor factories to verify implementation of approved line layouts.
* Check actual manpower allocation, machine positioning, operation sequence, and production flow against the approved layout.
* Monitor target achievement, line efficiency, productivity, and bottlenecks.
* Identify gaps between planned and actual performance and follow up with factory teams for corrective action.

**3. Video Study**

* Regularly visit vendor factories to conduct video/motion studies for products and operations.
* Analyse operator movements, operation methods, handling, and unnecessary motions.
* Identify the most efficient sewing methods and use findings to support SMV validation and reduction.
* Maintain records of improved methods and share best practices across factories.

**Key Requirements**

* 2–3 years' relevant experience in Garment Industrial Engineering.
* Strong practical knowledge of SMV, Line layout planning, method study, line balancing, and productivity improvement.
* Good understanding of garment sewing operations and manufacturing processes.
* Experience in conducting video/motion studies is preferred.
* Knowledge of SMV/IE software is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, observation, communication, and follow-up skills.
* Must be willing to travel regularly to vendor factories.
